text: Set up your weight loss plan

summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from a health or fitness app, specifically focused on weight loss. The main contents and functions on this screen include:

1. **Navigation Bar**: At the top, there is a navigation bar with a menu icon on the left and the title "Home" in the center.
2. **Set Up Your Weight Loss Plan**: A prominent button or section that allows users to set up their weight loss plan. This section is highlighted with an icon of a person walking.
3. **Create Your Profile**: A secondary button or section that is currently inactive or grayed out, indicating that the user needs to create their profile. This section is accompanied by an icon of a document and a pencil.

The screen is minimalistic, focusing on guiding the user to set up their weight loss plan and create their profile.
